meta.label: Agents: daily health triage sweep
meta.description: Deterministically scores every configured DSS host with the toolkit health score, drafts LLM recommendations for hosts under the threshold, persists to agents.agent_triage_daily, and emails a digest. RAISES if any host errors, so the scheduling scenario's failure reporter fires.

params.name: snapshot_enabled
params.label: Write daily snapshot zip
params.description: Zip every raw scan payload the sweep consumed (per host) into a managed folder, named admin-toolkit-snapshot-<YYMMDDHHMM>.zip

params.name: snapshot_folder
params.label: Snapshot folder (id or name)
params.description: Managed folder in this project to receive snapshot zips; empty = find-or-create 'admin-toolkit-snapshots'
